mapper.insert: insert into service_item (skiller_id, category_id, title, description, price, delivery_days, service_mode, tags, status, sales_count, avg_score, create_time, update_time) values (#{skillerId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{deliveryDays}, #{serviceMode}, #{tags}, #{status}, #{salesCount}, #{avgScore}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from service_item where skiller_id = #{skillerId} order by create_time desc

select si.id, si.skiller_id as skillerId, si.category_id as categoryId, si.title, si.description, si.price, si.delivery_days as deliveryDays, si.service_mode as serviceMode, si.tags, si.status, si.sales_count as salesCount, si.avg_score as avgScore, si.create_time as createTime, si.update_time as updateTime, sk.name as skillerName, sk.score as skillerScore, sk.credit_score as skillerCreditScore, sk.skill_level as skillerSkillLevel, c.name as categoryName from service_item si left join skiller sk on si.skiller_id = sk.id left join skill_category c on si.category_id = c.id
si.status = 1 and si.category_id = #{categoryId}
and (si.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or si.description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or si.tags like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by si.sales_count desc, si.avg_score desc

select si.id, si.skiller_id as skillerId, si.category_id as categoryId, si.title, si.description, si.price, si.delivery_days as deliveryDays, si.service_mode as serviceMode, si.tags, si.status, si.sales_count as salesCount, si.avg_score as avgScore, si.create_time as createTime, si.update_time as updateTime, sk.name as skillerName, sk.score as skillerScore, sk.credit_score as skillerCreditScore, sk.skill_level as skillerSkillLevel, c.name as categoryName from service_item si left join skiller sk on si.skiller_id = sk.id left join skill_category c on si.category_id = c.id where si.id = #{id}
